Find the weight of 6 slices of pizza.

Multiply 6 times the weight.

Multiply:

6 × 3 = 18


6 slices of pizza weigh 18 ounces.


Now compare 18 ounces to 1 pound.

1 pound is the same as 16 ounces. 18 ounces is more than 16 ounces.

18 ounces is more than 1 pound.


6 slices of pizza weigh more than 1 pound.

contents.html: A coin purse holds a volume of 6 fluid ounces. Is the volume of 10 coin purses greater than 6 cups?
A coin purse holds a volume of 6 fluid ounces. Is the volume of 10 coin purses greater than 6 cups?

content.html:
Find the volume of 10 coin purses.

Multiply 10 times the volume.

Multiply:

10 × 6 = 60


The volume of 10 coin purses is 60 fluid ounces.


Now compare 60 fluid ounces to 6 cups.

Find out how many fluid ounces are in 6 cups.

 Multiply 6 times the conversion above.

Multiply:

6 × 8 = 48


There are 48 fluid ounces in 6 cups.

60 is more than 48.

60 fluid ounces is more than 6 cups.


The volume of 10 coin purses is more than 6 cups.

content.html:
Find the length of 2 pieces of wood.

Multiply 2 times the length.

Multiply:

2 × 2 = 4


2 pieces of wood are 4 feet long.


Now compare 4 feet to 1 yard.

1 yard is the same as 3 feet. 4 feet is more than 3 feet.

4 feet is more than 1 yard.


2 pieces of wood are more than 1 yard long.
